assertion_audit.condition_to_fail: The reader stops recovering the injected reference saddle, or the EFIT-start probe is dropped so only the selected-saddle probe remains usable; distance_m then exceeds 1e-12.
The refresh path advances or rescales the saved state; the post-refresh state hash stops matching the pre-refresh hash.
The terminal topology read drifts from the solved receipt, e.g. a different mask or a changed admission rule; recomputed support then disagrees with record['support'].
The two arms stop sharing an admitted seed, or the head loses the augmented topology reader marker; the paired seed hashes differ or the count is not five.

A head frame loses its diverted class or the lower root moves past 1.8/0.5 cm, or MAST stops agreeing to round-off; the corresponding verdict flips to false, which is what happened and is recorded as passed=false.
A reader reverts to receipt.mask_history (AttributeError) or the persistence helper loses an entry; the fixture's [4, 0] is independently supplied and the assertion reads it back through the reader.

assertion_audit.self_comparisons: No retained assertion compares a value against the same variable it passed in: seeds are hashed from the request, distances are measured from saved terminal arrays loaded from npz, and the MAST round-off check compares two independent arm files. smoke.py:168 asserts row['mask_history'] == [4, 0] against a fixture value the reader must extract, not against its own input.
